title: EXP-007 — Form Description Persistence Across Verified Coupled Unload
objective: Create one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form named FX_FormPropertyLab05 using the verified basic-form recipe, record its exact scoped identity and baseline Form properties, intentionally edit only the Form-level Description to `Form Property Description Lab`, ordinary-save to a clean state, close the Form, read but do not change `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` and require it to be CHECKED/enabled, invoke `Form > Definition > Unload All Global Form Objects` exactly once, then reopen the exact same User-scope Form version and verify that Description persisted while the recorded comparison properties remained unchanged. Record browser and repository evidence without investigating cache internals or any unrelated Mongoose feature.

acceptance_checks.description: Before mutation, captured Select Form/store evidence proves zero exact and zero case-insensitive matches for FX_FormPropertyLab05 and records the current FX_ inventory/count.

Captured creation/reopen evidence proves exactly one new classic BuildFromScratch Form named FX_FormPropertyLab05 exists in User scope with the intended ScopeName, created using the verified basic-form procedure.
Before the Description edit, evidence records Name, ScopeType, ScopeName, Caption, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, and Is Master for the exact target Form version.

Evidence shows Description intentionally changed to exactly `Form Property Description Lab`, followed by ordinary Designer Save returning to a clean state; Caption and the other recorded comparison properties were not intentionally edited.

After the saved Form is closed and before any unload, read-only evidence proves `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` is CHECKED/enabled with no User Preference mutation; otherwise the experiment stops BLOCKED before AC-6.
Evidence captures the actual 2026.09.08 command label `Unload All Global Form Objects` and proves it was invoked exactly once after AC-5 passed.

After the unload, the exact same scoped version is reopened: Form Name=FX_FormPropertyLab05, ScopeType=User, and ScopeName matches the pre-edit baseline; the reopened Designer/effective Form definition shows Description exactly `Form Property Description Lab`.
Post-unload/reopen evidence shows Caption, Version, Device Type, Form Type, Is Master, ScopeType, and ScopeName equal their recorded baseline values.

Final read-only audit proves exactly one FX_FormPropertyLab05 exists, the reopened Designer still shows the expected Description, `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` remains CHECKED with no unsaved preference mutation, and repository changes are confined to the EXP-007 record and evidence/EXP-007/.
The experiment record classifies the result only as `observed` if AC-1 through AC-9 all pass; it must not promote a Description procedure to replay-verified until a separate clean replay succeeds.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261002-103246-mRo2. Rationale: EXP-006/EXP-006-R2 have replay-verified the save, close, preference-gate, explicit global-form-object unload, and exact scoped-version reopen procedure for a literal Form Caption. The smallest useful next step is to reuse that verified validation boundary for one different Form-level property rather than repeat Caption again or revisit the blocked variable topic. Description is a narrow scalar Form property that can be observed directly in Designer before and after the same cache boundary. This experiment therefore learns exactly one new capability: whether an intentionally edited User-scope Form Description survives ordinary Save followed by the already-verified coupled unload and reopen procedure.
